summary: Frontend-only regression test for the new ShedGrowthSidePanel added to MAIN shed data-entry tabs in BBM. Verified table width bug fix (previously ballooned to 1,000,000px), correct rendering of the sidebar/growth-curves/silo panel across all 6 shed groups, and correct suppression on non-shed tabs. Regression sanity (cell double-click edit, tab switching, no page errors) also passed.

layout_bug_fix.1920px_viewport: table bounding width = 1280px (bounded by maxWidth min(1280px,70vw))
layout_bug_fix.1366px_viewport: table bounding width = 1258px, side panel width = 409px, still fits

shed_side_panel.per_tab_result: shed-growth-side-panel present, correct pair of shed-side-box-<n> testids (e.g. box-1 & box-2 on '1 & 2'), 2 SVG growth-curve previews rendered, breed label (Ross 308) shown, shed-side-silo-panel present with graceful 'Silo Sync not connected for this shed group yet' fallback (expected on demo farm with no Silo Sync)
shed_side_panel.farm_buddy_tip: Not rendered because demo farm shows Placed='—' / Mortality=0 (age Day 172 with no placement data) — matches spec: graceful skip, not a crash

regression_sanity.cell_double_click_edit: PASS — input appears on dblclick of Ordered column cell

critical_code_review_comments: App.tsx is a very large monolith (>12k lines). ShedGrowthSidePanel additions add more surface area — recommend future refactor to split shed-tab render section and side-panel component into their own modules for maintainability.

The maxWidth: 'min(1280px, 70vw)' guard is effective, but 70vw on ultra-wide (>2560px) monitors will leave the table unnecessarily narrow while the sidebar can grow — consider a max on the sidebar and letting the table use a slightly larger cap. Not blocking.
test_credentials: Owner magic link (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md) used successfully — farm slug 'default'
seed_data_creation: None — used existing demo data on farm 'default'
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 shed-tab side panels (shed-side-box-<1..12>) verified rendering with growth SVGs; table width bounded to ~1280px at 1920 viewport and ~1258 at 1366 viewport. Silo panel currently in graceful fallback state (no Silo Sync data on demo farm) — this is expected. Farm Buddy tip only appears when there is placement data + age>0; not observable on this demo where placed='—'.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration. Prior 1,000,000px table width bug (flexbox + table-layout:fixed interaction) confirmed fixed by main agent's maxWidth+overflowX guard on the SheetView wrapping div.
